Lemma
[Curvature gap for Type III solutions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0201 1. ch21:21.19\group Notes and commentary

If an eternal solution on a compact manifold satisfies $\max |\Rm |(t)\le \alpha /t$ for all sufficiently large $t$, with $\alpha <1/(2(n-1))$, then \[ \operatorname {diam}(g(t))^2\max |\Rm |(t)\longrightarrow 0, \] so the metrics become almost flat in the sense of Gromov.
